input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance obligation anywhere (searches for insurance/coverage/certificates return nothing; the indemnity article at Section 12 and the miscellaneous provisions at Sections 13-30 are silent), yet TrueLink hosts our web site and processes Client Content and Credit Data. That is walk-away territory for a vendor handling personal/credit data, so we insert a short clause at the fallback level (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000) after Section 30, immediately before the signature block. We did not volunteer the preferred CGL, workers' compensation or certificate mechanics; those remain available if TrueLink prefers a fuller schedule.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Insert a short vendor insurance clause (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M) after Section 30
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance obligation even though TrueLink hosts our web site and processes Client and Credit Data, so we added our fallback coverage levels: errors and omissions of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.
